scoping_checkpoint.issue: The general goal of safer exploration is already crowded. Restrict the RQ to action-conditioned mismatch and require multiple physically executable routes.
scoping_checkpoint.resolution: Conditional probe only; novelty and action gates mandatory.

synthesis_checkpoint.issue: Incomplete final full texts for FIT/Help Me Through/degradation/MPC cannot support absent-mechanism claims.
synthesis_checkpoint.resolution: Explicit retrieval/read limits and unknowns; no global novelty claim.

final_checkpoint.issue: No controlled prospective route outcomes or evidence that simple feedback rules fail; backend itself already mitigates geometric degeneracy.
final_checkpoint.resolution: NO_CANDIDATE_QUALIFIED_FOR_METHOD_DEVELOPMENT. Deliver a falsifiable problem probe design without starting algorithm development.

strongest_counterargument: Observed improvements may be conventional health monitoring or buying observations with extra route cost; no new calibration mechanism has yet earned a causal task benefit.
